# Test fixture photos

Used only by tests and by `npm run collage:options` to render sample collages. All are CC0 or public domain.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| chelsea.png | scikit-image sample data, "Chelsea the cat", photo by Stéfan van der Walt | CC0 |
| coffee.png | scikit-image sample data, "Coffee cup", photo by Rachel Michetti (courtesy of Pikolo Espresso Bar) | CC0 |
| camera.png | scikit-image sample data, photo by Lav Varshney | CC0 |
| rocket.jpg | scikit-image sample data, DSCOVR launch on Falcon 9, SpaceX | Public domain |
| hubble_deep_field.jpg | scikit-image sample data, Hubble eXtreme Deep Field, NASA | Public domain |
